title: known positive: duplicate value in a matrix axis

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI
on:
  push:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node: [18, 20, 20]
    steps:
      - run: npm test

title: known positive: include entry repeats an existing combination

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI
on:
  push:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node: [18, 20]
        include:
          - node: 20
    steps:
      - run: npm test

title: legitimate exception: include adds a new key to an existing combination

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:

  push:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node: [18, 20]
        include:
          - node: 20
            experimental: true
    steps:
      - run: npm test

title: known positive: two-axis include repeats a full existing combination

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: CI

  push:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node: [18, 20]
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            node: 20
    steps:
      - run: npm test
